newsitem.title: UK: IGC trims world wheat trade estimate by one mln T.
newsitem.headline: IGC trims world wheat trade estimate by one mln T.

text.p: The International Grains Council on Thursday cut its estimate for 1996-97 world wheat trade to 91 million tonnes from its previous estimate of 92 million made a month ago.
The figure compares with 89 million tonnes in 1995-96.
The biggest cut was for China where The IGC lowered its estimate for China's wheat imports by one million tonnes to 4.0 million. It also cut Russia's imports by 400,000 tonnes to 1.0 million.
Estimated imports by Iran were raised by 500,000 tonnes to 5.0 million.

Among exporters, the IGC added 1.5 million tonnes to its estimate for Asutralia, bringing its exports to 17.0 million tonnes. And it cut 500,000 tonnes from Canada's estimated exports to 17.5 million.
